questions.q: The intensity or magnitude of an earthquake is recorded by which instrument?
questions.exp: A seismograph records ground vibrations; magnitude is expressed on the Richter scale.

questions.q: Rainwater harvesting is mainly done to
questions.exp: Collecting and storing rainwater helps recharge aquifers and reduces dependence on groundwater.

questions.q: Organic farming mainly avoids the use of
questions.exp: Organic farming relies on compost, manure and biological pest control.

questions.q: 12 men can complete a work in 20 days. How many days will 15 men take?
questions.exp: Work = 12 x 20 = 240 man-days; 240/15 = 16 days.

questions.q: A shopkeeper marks goods 40% above cost price and allows a discount of 10%. What is his profit percent?
questions.exp: SP = 1.4 x 0.9 = 1.26 of CP, so profit = 26%.

questions.q: What is the volume of a cone of base radius 6 cm and height 7 cm? (π = 22/7)
In an isosceles triangle the vertex angle is 40°. What is each base angle?
questions.exp: Base angles are equal: (180° - 40°)/2 = 70°.

questions.q: What is the average of the first 10 even natural numbers?
If the English alphabet is written in reverse order (Z first, A last), which letter will be 10th from the left?
questions.exp: In reverse order the 10th letter from the left is the 10th from the right of the normal alphabet, i.e. position 27 − 10 = 17, which is Q.

questions.q: If 15 August 2021 was a Sunday, then on which day did 15 August 2023 fall?
questions.exp: The period from 15 Aug 2021 to 15 Aug 2023 has 730 days (no leap day in between). 730 mod 7 = 2, so Sunday + 2 = Tuesday.

questions.q: Five persons Ram, Shyam, Tina, Uma and Vinay sit in a row facing north. Shyam sits at an extreme end and Tina sits immediately to his right. Uma sits at the other extreme end. Ram does not sit next to Tina. Who sits in the middle?
questions.exp: Shyam is at the left end (Tina is to his right), Tina is 2nd and Uma is 5th. Ram and Vinay take places 3 and 4; Ram cannot be next to Tina, so Ram is 4th and Vinay is 3rd, the middle.

questions.q:
Statements: Some teachers are poets. Some poets are doctors.
Conclusions: I. Some teachers are doctors. II. Some doctors are teachers.
questions.exp: The teacher-poets and the doctor-poets may be different sets of poets, so no relation between teachers and doctors can be concluded.
